stemMd: A driver plans to travel 150 km at 50 km/h. After travelling 50 km at that speed, a delay of 30 minutes occurs. At what constant speed must the remaining distance be travelled to arrive at the planned time?
explanationMd: The planned trip takes 3 hours. One hour of driving plus half an hour delay leaves 1.5 hours for 100 km. Speed must be 100/1.5=200/3 km/h.

distractorRationale.c: This arrives earlier than the planned time.
distractorRationale.b: This uses only one hour despite 1.5 hours remaining.
distractorRationale.a: This takes too long for the remaining 100 km.
